definitions.gloss: visual; relating to sight; pertaining to vision
definitions.explanation: Relating to or experienced through the sense of sight. A な-adjective used to describe things that appeal to or involve visual perception.

examples.japanese: {視覚的|しかくてき}な{効果|こうか}。
{視覚的|しかくてき}に{分|わ}かりやすい{資料|しりょう}を{作|つく}った。
グラフを{使|つか}って{視覚的|しかくてき}に{表現|ひょうげん}することで、データが{理解|りかい}しやすくなる。
examples.english: By expressing data visually with graphs, it becomes easier to understand.

notes:
Composed of {視覚|しかく} (vision, visual sense) + {的|てき} (suffix making な-adjectives). A formal word common in academic, design, and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {視覚的|しかくてき}な{効果|こうか}: visual effect
- {視覚的|しかくてき}に{表現|ひょうげん}する: to express visually
- {視覚的|しかくてき}な{情報|じょうほう}: visual information
- {視覚的|しかくてき}に{訴|うった}える: to appeal visually

RELATED WORDS:
- {聴覚的|ちょうかくてき}: auditory (relating to hearing)
- {触覚的|しょっかくてき}: tactile (relating to touch)
- ビジュアル: visual (loanword; more casual, often used in fashion/entertainment)
